blocks.text:
Planning for your new baby can be overwhelming. Simplify your prep list with a Lansinoh breastfeeding starter set that has products loved by moms and recommended by doctors. A great baby shower gift, this set includes everything new moms need to start breastfeeding with confidence, from soothing nipple cream and hot and cold therapy packs to a silicone breast pump and more.
Rich, spreadable Lanolin Nipple Cream provides soothing protection for your sore nipples. TheraPearl 3-in-1 Breast Therapy Packs provide hot and cold pain relief for your tender breasts. Stay Dry Disposable Nursing Pads prevent leaks to keep you dry day and night. Our hands-free Silicone Breast Pump helps you collect every drop of breastmilk while you breastfeed on the opposite breast. Finally, protect every ounce with Lansinoh’s super strong Breastmilk Storage Bags, designed for safe storage and freezing.
Includes: 48 Disposable Nursing Pads, 25 Lansinoh Breastmilk Storage Bags, 1 Lanolin Nipple Cream 7gr, 2 Breast Therapy Packs, and 1 Silicone Breast Pump.
For nearly 40 years, new mothers have trusted Lansinoh to support and care for them while they enter the messy magic of motherhood. Born from one mother’s realization that birthing people often go without the support they need and deserve, Lansinoh proudly stands with mothers all over the world. Our journey started with award winning, doctor recommended HPA Lanolin Nipple Cream: today, we offer a comprehensive collection of solutions to help new parents navigate pregnancy, birth, breastfeeding, and pumping. Our product range includes organic nipple balm, disposable nursing pads, washable nursing pads, breastmilk storage bags, manual breast pumps and double electric breast pumps, postpartum essentials, baby bottles, and more. Lansinoh products are available in more than 70 countries and the company is committed to being climate neutral by 2030.

items: ESSENTIALS FOR NEW MOMS - A great baby shower gift, the You’ve Got This Breastfeeding Essentials Kit includes everything moms need to start nursing with confidence, from soothing nipple cream and breast therapy packs to a silicone breast pump and more

BREASTFEEDING KIT INCLUDES - These hospital bag essentials include 48 Lansinoh Nursing Pads, 25 Lansinoh Breastmilk Storage Bags, 2 Lansinoh Breast Therapy Packs, 1 Lanolin Nipple Cream 7gr, 1 Silicone Breast Pump

PERFECT BABY REGISTRY ITEMS - These Lansinoh essentials in a kit, covering breast care, leak protection, and milk storage, make an ideal postpartum essentials gift for new moms and ensure a comfortable start to the breastfeeding journey
100% NATURAL AND SAFE FOR BABY – No need to remove lansinoh nipple cream before breastfeeding. Made with a single natural ingredient, and never any petroleum, parabens, fragrance, or taste
RELIEF FOR TENDER BREASTS - Lansinoh breast therapy packs provide therapeutic relief for the most common nursing challenges

PUMPING AND STORING - Our silicone breast pump creates natural suction to catch every drop of breastmilk hands-free, while our super strong lansinoh milk storage bags with reinforced double-sealed seams protect and freeze your precious milk safely
